question: A material has high retentivity and high coercivity. Explain why this material is more suitable for making a permanent magnet than an electromagnet.

options.A: The material is suitable for an electromagnet because high retentivity helps it lose magnetism immediately when current is switched off.
options.B: The material is unsuitable for permanent magnets because high coercivity means it is easily demagnetised.
options.C: The material is equally suitable for permanent magnets and electromagnets because both require high retentivity and high coercivity.
options.D: High retentivity helps the material retain magnetisation, and high coercivity makes it resist demagnetisation, so it is suitable for a permanent magnet. It is not suitable for an electromagnet because an electromagnet must magnetise and demagnetise easily.
